title: Formalize cover graph characterization (Pretzel) without axioms

problemStatement.formal: Prove the Pretzel/Brightwell characterization that robustly acyclic orientations are exactly cover graphs, removing the `cover_graph_characterization` axiom.
problemStatement.plain: Can the cover-graph characterization of robustly acyclic orientations be proved directly in Lean instead of assumed as an axiom?
whyMatters: This would replace the main OQ01 characterization axiom with a checked proof.

proven: Erdos1006OQ01 proves empty and bipartite graphs admit rank-based robust orientations and that cover graphs admit robust orientations.
The broader Erdos1006 family also contains cover-recognition scaffolding, FFLLW/classical witness work, and OQ04 decidability support.
open: The reverse Pretzel/Brightwell direction from robustly acyclic orientations to cover graphs still needs a direct formalization.
knownResults.goal: Replace the characterization axiom with a direct Lean proof.

currentState.focus: Metadata refreshed against the current seven-file Erdos1006 proof family; the target remains the axiom-removal version of the cover-graph characterization.
currentState.nextAction: Audit the Pretzel/Brightwell reverse direction and identify a small formal sublemma that can replace part of `cover_graph_characterization`.
